_help: Level 1 agent offers currently open (from screenshots). isk = cash reward, bonus = time-bonus ISK, taxed = 11% corp tax applies (Rounaminck step 1 paid untaxed; step 2 unknown so treated as taxed). loot = items you receive (priced from the scanned market, else 'est' per unit). cost = items you must buy to finish. granted = items given on accept (not counted). Edit this file after each new screenshot. task_min = your time at the agent's station for the task; jumps = jumps from Rotonos to the agent (travel counted both ways at min_per_jump minutes per jump); available=false hides an agent with no current offer.
